script_text: Hold your breath, Aries — Uranus just slammed into your 4th House, shaking the foundations of your home life. Beware of impulsive spending triggered by the Venus‑Mars tension in your 2nd House of finances — keep receipts handy. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss what the cosmos has in store.
